**Describe the desired behavior when the feature is implemented**
E.g. I would like the program to automatically upload the .csv file to Google Drive after it is generated.

**Technical context**
Suggested libraries, architectural considerations, potential vulnerabilities etc.

**Complexity estimate**
0 - one-liner
1 - a few lines of code
2 or 3 - a new class / component
5 - multi-component implementation / complex testing / thorough research
8 - all of the above
